survivors_flagged.one_line: Two readouts due in Q4 2026: bosakitug Ph2 in atopic dermatitis (n=109) and ATI-052 Ph1b PoC in asthma and AD. Stock fell from a ~$5.56 50d avg to $3.83, so the binaries are not priced in. Early-arc, but still plain biotech binary risk.

Mitapivat sickle-cell sNDA (Priority Review, accelerated approval) has a PDUFA date of Nov-1-2026. Stock is down about 29% in 3 months after the tebapivat failure, so it is not run up into the binary. Approval risk and the label/REMS framing are the asymmetry. No AdCom was found.

verified.catalyst: Topline results from the randomized, placebo-controlled Phase 2 of bosakitug (anti-TSLP, ATI-045) in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (n=109, primary endpoint % change in EASI at week 24). Phase 1b proof-of-concept readouts for ATI-052 (TSLP/IL-4Ra bispecific) in asthma and AD are due in the same window.
verified.dated_milestone: Company guidance is 4Q 2026 for bosakitug Ph2 topline (enrollment closed Mar-2026; reaffirmed in the Q2 release on 2026-08-06; July-2026 investor snapshot says 4Q26). ATI-052 Ph1b PoC readouts were reaffirmed 2026-08-06 for 2H26. Next: Q3 2026 earnings, expected early Nov 2026. Readout window is Oct-Dec 2026.
verified.bloom_gates: G2 only: a concrete, dated company commitment (4Q26 topline, reaffirmed 2026-08-06). No G1 (no named counterparty or partner economics). No G3 (no specific unpriced figure; the upside depends on efficacy, not a contractual number).
verified.edge: L-M. This is a clean, dated, unfired binary, but there is no informational edge on the outcome. The prior Ph2a evidence (94% EASI-75 at wk26) came from a small single-arm study, and TSLP has a mixed record in AD (tezepelumab missed). (a) Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: about +28% from roughly $3.0 at the start of 2026, derived from AAII's mid-Sept YTD of +83.55% at ~$5.5. Most of the 2026 run-up (to a $6.60 high) has already been given back after a ~35% fall since mid-Sept, from a $5.17-6.27 range to $3.83. (b) Remaining capture: about +60-100% to roughly $6-7.5 on a clean win, which means retaking and exceeding the $6.60 high. This is an estimate, not derived from a model. On a miss the downside is about -50-60% toward the cash and modzatinib floor (~$1.5-2). Asymmetry is roughly even at coin-flip odds.

FMP quote 2026-10-12: $3.83, 50d avg $5.56, 52w range $1.74-6.60. AAII auto-article 2026-09-15: YTD +83.55%, Sept range $5.17-6.27.
verified.analysis: The catalyst is real and forward: bosakitug Ph2 AD topline is guided to 4Q26, with ATI-052 Ph1b PoC readouts in 2H26, and nothing has fired as of 2026-10-12 (latest press release is from 2026-09-03). The setup is plain biotech binary risk on an efficacy outcome with no contractual floor. The stock's ~35% slide from mid-September has no company news behind it in FMP press releases or stock news; that is an unresolved gap (competitor TSLP read-through, a financing overhang or pre-readout de-risking cannot be ruled out). Runway through 2028 (Q2 release) limits near-term dilution risk. Score capped at 4/WATCH: the event is dated, but the edge is uninformed coin-flip odds and the drawdown cause is unverified. Numerator provenance does not apply (binary lane, no SoP upside claimed), and the cash balance was not re-read from the 10-Q.

verified.catalyst: FDA action on the mitapivat sNDA for sickle cell disease (accelerated approval, Priority Review). The PDUFA goal date is 2026-11-01.
verified.dated_milestone: PDUFA 2026-11-01 (a Sunday, so the action could come as early as Fri 2026-10-30). Next marker: label and REMS text at approval. Novo's etavopivat filing (2H26) is the competitive overhang that follows.
verified.instrument: AGIO common (no preferred, no material debt). A defined-risk options structure through the PDUFA date is preferable to outright stock because the binary is roughly symmetric.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 yes (named counterparty: the FDA, PDUFA 2026-11-01, Priority Review accepted 2026-07-07). G2 yes (concrete dated regulatory commitment). G3 weak: no specific unpriced figure. SCD peak sales are contested after the RISE UP pain-crisis co-primary miss (Nov 2025) and with etavopivat close behind.
verified.edge: M-/L+. RESIDUAL CAPTURE: (a) Run-up from the pre-catalyst base. The accelerated-approval path became knowable on 2026-03-31; the 2026-03-30 close was $29.61, so the run-up to $31.81 is +7%. The stock is +42% from the post-topline low of $22.34 (2025-11-19) and -15% from $37.39 just before the Priority Review news. It is not run up. (b) Remaining to the favorable-resolution value: about $38-40, +20-25%. That is derived and not contractual: it reverses the post-tebapivat de-rating back toward the $37-44 range seen after acceptance. The CRL downside is about $23-24 (-25%), toward the Nov-2025 low; the cash floor is about $16/sh (~$965M cash on 6/30/26, ~60M shares). With approval odds around 75-80% (the FDA itself steered Agios to the accelerated-approval path), expected value is modestly positive but not asymmetric. The real asymmetry sits in label and REMS breadth (whether the hepatocellular-injury REMS carries over from thalassemia/AQVESME, and whether the Hb-surrogate label omits pain-crisis claims). That cannot be priced from public data.

verified.analysis: Verified as real, dated and forward. The sNDA was submitted 2026-05-12 under accelerated approval after FDA engagement, Priority Review was granted 2026-07-07, PDUFA is 2026-11-01 and no decision has been found. The RISE UP Phase 3 met the hemoglobin-response endpoint (40.6%) but missed the co-primary on pain crises (Nov 2025, -51% day), so approval rests on a surrogate the FDA invited. Approval looks likely, but commercial value is capped by the missed pain endpoint and by Novo's etavopivat, which met its endpoint 2026-04-20 (AGIO -23% that day) and files in 2H26. Equity is clean: market cap $1.90B against about $965M cash, giving EV around $0.9-1.0B, with PKD/thalassemia revenue on top. The provenance check found no preferred stack, so the event value flows through to common. The unresolved gap is the label/REMS framing; no AdCom was verified. Gross remaining upside is about +20-25% against about -25% on a CRL, so this is a WATCH binary rather than an ACTIVE one.
